WAR (unreleased James Blake, Ye, and No I.D. collaborative album)
WAR is an unreleased collaborative album made by James Blake, Ye, and No I.D. It was first worked on in April of 2022, shortly after the release of Donda 2 to the Stem Player.  The album was shelved in wake of Ye's numerous antisemitic comments. Many songs intended to be on the album were reworked for other albums, including VULTURES 1, and Ye's upcoming solo album, BULLY.
It was first worked on in April of 2022, shortly after the release of Donda 2 to the Stem Player. Ye first previewed songs from the album at a club in London on September 26th, 2022, through British supermodel Naomi Campbell's Instagram Live. X user kanyewestaurant would post clips of the new songs playing, claiming that the song sampled "[https://genius.com/James-blake-always-lyrics Always]" by James Blake. However, Blake would later take to X to tweet that the song did not sample "Always", and that it was new.
